colour_words.how: fitted with the likeness to each family's words, folded into the embedding's weights (heads.fold_words)

card.note: Scores are held out: every vehicle answered by heads trained on the other 4 of 5 folds. The heads written were then trained on all. Some settings (C, REAL_WRONG, SURE_RIGHT, WORDS_WEIGHT) were picked after looking at these same held-out scores: they may flatter them a little.
